title: Tusker Lodge
subtitle: Kill Male Tusker (level 20), no quest
steps: In the Facility Hub, take the level 15 portal to Tusker Lodge.
Kill Male Tusker in the dungeon.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Tuskers take 0.25 to 0.4 electric, 0.5 slash, 0.75 bludgeon, cold and acid, and full pierce (1.0) and fire (1.0). Use pierce or fire.

notes.title: Leaving
notes.body: The entrance is at the bottom. The only Surface exit is at the top of the dungeon.
